end.parentNote: Asha practised the five 3D shapes through everyday objects and descriptions of faces and curved surfaces. Ishita correctly matched examples such as a dice to a cube, a sipper bottle to a cylinder, a funnel to a cone, and a long pencil box to a cuboid. There was an earlier mix-up about identifying the cuboid, and it was clarified later when Ishita described the long box with flat sides and distinguished it from a cube. At home, ask Ishita to find one object for each shape and say its name and one feature.
